evidence.reason: The preflight completion-budget check refuses only `service_type == "simple"` and unbounded service timeouts. It has no check for a bounded oneshot target with `RemainAfterExit=yes`, which remains active after the explicit start; the restored timer cannot restart an active service, so the required second distinct completion cannot arrive. This is an ordinary correctness gap in the existing two-completion precondition, not a new requirement.
